grammar.summary: 本课学习购物找零场景句型与 another 的用法。

points.title: another 表"再来一个"
points.explanation: another = an + other，接单数可数名词：I want another envelope.（再要一个信封）。已有一个还想再要时用 another。

points.title: That's all 表"就这些"
points.explanation: 购物结束时说 That's all, thank you. 表示不需要别的了。

examples.en: Is that all? That's all, thank you.
